title: AgentCallRecord
description: Per-LLM-call audit record (FR-024, cross-cutting). Lives at _pipeline/cycles/cycle-NNN/agent-calls/<ts>-<stage>-<call-id>.json.
$comment: SUPERSEDED (#295): the agent-calls/ directory this schema describes is real and actively written, but not in this shape — the shipped sidecar (scripts/agent_call.py) has always used the spec-028 fields (schema_version, agent_kind, exit_code, cycle, ...), never this schema's call_id/prompt/response/latency_ms/tokens_in/tokens_out shape. tests/fixtures/contracts/agent-call-sidecar-1.1.schema.json is the contract that actually matches what ships and is validated by tests/scripts/test_agent_call_sidecar_v1.py. Kept for spec-020 history rather than deleted, since the directory it names is real; do not wire new code to this shape.

model.description: Resolved model identifier (post-tier resolution per D7).

oneOf.description: Resolved tier name (e.g. 'basic'); null when the executor used legacy model: field.

prompt.description: Full prompt text. NOT truncated per FR-024.

response.description: Full response text. NOT truncated per FR-024.

oneOf.description: Traceback if the call failed; null on success.

retry_attempt.description: Present for D9 retry-once contexts; absent otherwise.
